_schema_help.question: What exact visual values must all screens and components reuse?
_schema_help.status: Illustrative values only, not project approval. Stage 5 replaces proposals with owner choices; Stage 6 may add extensions without changing the pinned foundation.
_schema_help.ownership: Stage 5 agent authors the foundation; Stage 6 agent maintains extensions. The owner decides at Stages 5 and 8.
_schema_help.consumption: The catalogue uses property=token.name bindings. The manifest pins this entire file. audit:prototype checks types, aliases, pins and references; agents and rendered tests check visual correctness.
_schema_help.types: color: #RRGGBB/#RRGGBBAA; dimension: nonnegative px/rem/em; fontFamily: family/fallback string; fontWeight: 100-900; number: nonnegative. {name} aliases the same type; no cycles.
_schema_help.foundation: Canonical hash of foundation is recorded as UI foundation SHA-256 in ui-ux-decision.md. Foundation cannot depend on extensions.
_schema_help.extensions: Add only scope-needed tokens within the approved foundation. Cannot shadow foundation names. Changes to approved files repeat review/approval.

foundation.component_library: Framework-neutral shared component catalogue; implementation adapter selected with architecture
foundation.icon_set: Lucide (subject to owner choice and platform compatibility)
